properties.name: FIELD REPORT (flo2, 2026-09-18): collapse_decision cannot settle a decision whose options live in prose (the brainstorm skill's own design), and saying which option won means re-sending the whole body; MEASURED on this design: 210 of 743 decisions exceed 4 KB, 164 carry dated ═══ sections, 92 preserved re-sends exist
properties.source: flo2 reflow2_feedback.md, session 2026-09-18 (Anthony's own project; the agent triaging was this session, root-cause skill run at Anthony's prompt)
properties.statement: F3 and F4 are one finding: the settle-a-prose-decision path has no structured home for 'option (b) won' and amending a sentence costs the whole field, so the reporter left 'Options, none chosen' standing as a false line. SEARCHED: fact:defect-the-reply-costs-more-than-the-answer-and-amending-prose-costs-the-whole-field (2026-09-04, two projects) and dec:idea-should-a-node-say-it-has-layers-and-let-a-reader-ask-for-them (OPEN) record the same cost; the house style the graph encourages is measured above. The revision guard preserves the prior state (snap:epoch:preserved-on-write), which protects against loss, not against transcription.
